_comment: Sample operator config for BOP Raxaul — Pillar 42 (backend/src/data/mockData.js CAMERAS[0]). Loaded and hot-reloaded by rules.config.ConfigStore. The HTTP endpoints an operator would edit this through are Phase 8 — for now this file is hand-edited.

fences.name: pillar-42-line
fences._comment: Vertical line at x=320, matching the MEASUREMENTS.md section 2 rule-sanity fence.

loitering._comment: net_displacement_m is used once the homography below is trustworthy; net_displacement_px is the fallback and is what MEASUREMENTS.md section 2 was measured against (no homography existed for that clip).

homography._comment: Four operator-picked points: a 5m x 5m square marked out on the ground in front of the camera. image_points are pixel coordinates the operator clicked on a frame_size (width x height) view; world_points are the corresponding real-world metres, origin at the near-left corner. The engine rescales the points to the live stream's resolution, and refuses the calibration (falling back to pixel thresholds) if the live aspect ratio differs.
